practical: Review of FCS Block Diagram and FADEC Logic Flow; Safety: Do not touch live avionics; Instructor supervision required for diagram analysis.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an engine control system?
How did analog control systems differ from digital systems?
Why is digital control preferred for modern aero engines?

topics: Definition of Full Authority Digital Control
Role of FADEC in Engine Management
Benefits of Digital Over Analog Control
development.content:
Definition of Full Authority Digital Control
Comparison with Analog Control Systems
Role of FADEC in Engine Management
Sensors and Actuators in FCS
Benefits of Digital Over Analog Control

FADEC Architecture and Components
Engine Parameters Monitored by FCS
Control Logic and Decision Making
Fail-Safe Mechanisms in FCS
Integration with Aircraft Flight Control

Advantages of FCS in Performance
Maintenance Implications of Digital Systems
Future Trends in Engine Control
Troubleshooting Common FCS Issues
Summary of FCS Principles

summary_questions: Explain the difference between full authority and limited authority digital control.
Describe how FADEC ensures engine safety during a sensor failure.
List three advantages of digital control systems over analog systems.
